name: video-testimonials
title: Video testimonials
description: Customer video cards with a poster, a visible play button and the length; a press opens the video in an accessible dialog and stops it on close.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and videos ({ id, name, role, poster, src?, duration, captions? }); three is the layout it is made for. A card is one real button named like "Play Maria's story, 2 minutes 14 seconds" (spoken with Intl; labels.play translates it), with the poster always visible, a play disc, and the name, role and length as text. Nothing about the video is fetched before the press. A press opens a Dialog with a native video (controls, preload none, a captions track from captions: { src, lang, label? } switched on) and starts it; closing pauses it, Escape closes, and focus returns to the card. A video that fails shows a message. A card whose poster is missing or fails to load shows the initials in a small tile in the corner, and keeps the middle for the play button; give posters open ground in the middle (the speaker off to one side). To host the video elsewhere pass renderPlayer(video) returning your embed (className="absolute inset-0 size-full"): it only mounts when its card is pressed. Only the card is a client component.
